model: Versatec Single Compressor Water-to-Water Heat Pump (FX10)
applies_to: WaterFurnace Versatec single-compressor water-to-water heat pumps with the FX10 DDC controller.
summary: BACnet objects for WaterFurnace's single-compressor Versatec water-to-water heat pump on the FX10 DDC controller. The BAS sends the compressor (Y1) and reversing valve (O) calls, and reads load/source water temperatures, refrigerant freeze temperatures, flow switches and an enumerated alarm code.
notes: Output-type points are volatile and fall back to uncommanded after a power cycle; unlimited writes.
The sheet lists no AV/MV points for this unit; all writable points are volatile outputs.
No engineering units are printed in the source; temperatures are presumably degrees F.
Binary input 3:5 is not listed in the sheet; the numbering jumps from BI 4 to BI 6.
MO4 Application Mode and MO5 Heat Cool Mode are marked 'do not use' and have no stated access; listed here as read-only.
The sheet does not state the BACnet transport.

points.name: Alarms Enumerated
points.states: 1=Load Flow Fault; 2=Compressor 1 Low Pressure; 3=Compressor 1 Source Freeze; 4=Compressor 1 Load Freeze; 5=Source Flow Fault; 6=Compressor 1 Hi Pressure; 7=Compressor 1 Bad Source Freeze Sensor; 8=Compressor 1 Bad Load Freeze Sensor

points.name: Emergency Override
points.description: Network emergency shutdown of all outputs

points.name: Application Mode
points.description: Not used; WaterFurnace advises against writing it

points.name: Heat Cool Mode
points.description: Not used; WaterFurnace advises against writing it

points.name: Alarm Reset
points.description: Reset manual-reset alarms: write 2, then back to 1

integration.summary: The BAS stages this unit directly: MO2 is the compressor (Y1) call and MO3 the reversing valve (O) call. MO1 gives a network emergency shutdown and MO6 resets manual-reset alarms. Supervise it with the load water temperatures, the flow switches and the AI9 alarm code.
integration.enable: This sheet lists no enable point: the BAS controls the unit by writing the compressor (MO2, Y1) and reversing valve (MO3, O) calls. WaterFurnace's other FX10 water-to-water sheets say these units run only on external Y1/O calls, from the terminal board or the network. MO1 Emergency Override shuts down all outputs and overrides the compressor minimum run timers.
gotchas: Output points (AO/MO) are volatile and go back to uncommanded after a power cycle, so rewrite them after power is restored.
MO3 uses 1=Heating, 2=Cooling on this sheet; the Versatec dual-compressor sheet uses the opposite order, so check before reusing a template.
Do not write MO4 Application Mode or MO5 Heat Cool Mode; WaterFurnace recommends leaving them alone.
Alarm Reset needs a write of 2 followed by 1.
